limitations: Import and instancing are geometric only. No visual, lighting, walking, packaged or cook acceptance is established by this script.

Every parapet, tank, collector, condenser, dish, aerial, washing line, stair house, dome, awning, vault and stall is AUTHORED massing in the style of the modern Jerusalem roofscape. Only the stone ordinance and the ubiquity of solar water heating are sourced; nothing here is surveyed, photogrammetric, a claim about a particular building, or halachic.

Instances are placed in two zones so the Yechezkel precinct plaza can hide the half it covers together with the buildings it covers. This script does not itself teach the precinct system about the two new actor labels; that is a one-line addition to the precinct hide set and is recorded in the receipt as an open item.
Souq fittings stand on the terrain height under the street station, not on the street mesh.
The retint is off by default and, when on, is a per-component override in the level, not an asset edit. It is reversible with -CityDetailRetintClear.
Actor count rises by up to 24. That is deliberate: the measured bottleneck is the game thread carrying 7,767 actors, so this addition is instanced, not per-building.
